description.value: CAVU Kitchen Bar is a regional-cuisine restaurant and bar situated within (or alongside) the Hilton in Richmond, serving breakfast, an all-day menu, and happy hour. The kitchen produces house-smoked brisket, OceanWise seafood, and a broad range of globally inflected small plates and mains. The venue also hosts regular public events including themed brunches and Paint Nites, giving it a lively community atmosphere.
